## GraphBuilder.provider() method

A provider: a loader's value projected into rows of fields, each with its `Meta`<!-- -->, plus the  fields derived from them.

**Signature:**

```typescript
provider<const Id extends string, N extends keyof E & string, V, LN extends Attrs, CP, LH extends Attrs, R extends object, D extends Readonly<Record<string, DerivedField<R, unknown, Meta>>> = Empty>(id: Id, spec: {
        readonly loader: Loader<N, KeyOf<E, N>, V, LN, CP, LH>;
        readonly temporal: "historical" | "current";
        readonly rows: "one" | "many";
        readonly project: (value: V, key: KeyOf<E, N>) => readonly R[];
        readonly raw: RawFields<R, Meta>;
        readonly derived?: (d: DeriveMaker<R, Meta>) => D & {
            readonly [P in keyof R]?: never;
        };
        readonly caps?: {
            readonly rows?: number;
        };
    }): NamedFields<R, Provider<Id, N, R, D, Meta>>;
```
